findings.definition: The affected bundled HTTP/1.1 response parser and reused-socket dispatch path are not invoked by the frozen upload entry point. Dependency/module loading and optional ProxyAgent construction occur, but are not transport dispatch.

The affected implementation is included and is conditionally code-reachable in the exact frozen upload invocation. Its XML response input cannot be selected or populated with arbitrary entity syntax by a repository contributor under the frozen trusted-tool/data and hosted-service trust boundaries. Malicious XML control requires a trusted hosted endpoint/service or authenticated transport/runner trust failure. This is not a claim that the dependency is patched or that parser resource limits fully mitigate it.
